hooks.name: Keep the API client in sync
hooks.description: After saving an API route or schema file, regenerate the typed API client and report whether it changed.

action.prompt: An API route or schema file was just saved. Run `make client` from the repository root. Then run `git status --short packages/api-client`. If the generated client changed, tell me in one sentence which endpoints or schemas changed, and remind me to commit packages/api-client together with the API change. If nothing changed, say "API client already in sync" and nothing else.
